cpuChecksMeaning.kind: structural, window-termination and guard checks only — deliberately not a mirror of any test count
atomicSamplerStructure: the injected installer is ONE arrow-function body with no async/await, so a record cannot be stitched across turns

the installer actually reads every required signal: __paravoxiaCommonGround.snapshot (score/beat/anchors), __paravoxiaJourneyProbe.getSnapshot (story active/chapter/beat/runId, avFull complete+handback, common units), __voxBundleDiag (heldChain + trace tail), __voxAudioDiag, document visibility/hidden/hasFocus, __autopilot/__auditWorker identity
the installer contains no game-state write, no localStorage write, no AudioContext construction, no dispatchEvent
eventWindowTermination: completion edge requires beat done/active false AND complete AND handback in AV history (a beat-only flip is refused as the edge)
the sampler is still running at edge+11000 ms and seals at edge+11500 ms
retained window preEdge 3000 ms + postEdge 11500 ms = 14.5 s of retention around an ~12 s requirement
no-edge and truncated-window terminations are named failures, never a pass
pre-edge ring trimming keeps the trailing 3 s; post-edge samples are never trimmed; a memory cap hit is reported, not hidden

the single tolerated non-game auxiliary mismatch is exactly the delta run-profile already recorded in producer-nonbinding-auxiliary-observation.json

a non-empty output dir is refused

preparedCommandLine.prerequisite: root sets verifier-control.json activeRole=finale-window-runtime and $LOCK to the run's existing shared heavy lock path
preparedCommandLine.lane: movie, ordinary shipped autopilot; the probe sends no key input and performs no store/pose/anchor/progress/audio write
preparedCommandLine.estimatedWallTime: ~70-90 s to the completion edge on the observed journey-common-1 timing, plus 11.5 s of retained window

measurementDesign.atomicity: ONE synchronous in-page function per record, executed from a rAF callback (driver=raf; a bounded setTimeout driver exists as a justified fallback only if rAF is throttled). This replaces the three stitched awaited reads that produced E1 of the lifecycle audit.
measurementDesign.window: from arming (mid ch13, before completion) with a 3 s retained pre-edge tail, through 11.5 s after a complete+handback edge; real performance.now()/rAF timestamps plus performance.timeOrigin and Date.now() per record
measurementDesign.cdpDiscipline: between arming and sealing the probe issues ZERO screenshots; only a tiny status() poll at 2 Hz crosses CDP. The buffer is serialized after sealing, so no CDP round trip can lose the completion edge.
measurementDesign.frames: one pre-window baseline frame at arm time, then exactly three post-seal frames, each with its own atomic before/after sample, real shot duration and an explicit label that they are NOT the completion edge and NOT simultaneous with either state read. No per-frame screenshots.
measurementDesign.finalStatusRetention: the window keeps sampling for the full 11.5 s after the edge even though beat is already 'done' and the CG token reads null.

exposedAndCaptured: __paravoxiaJourneyProbe.getSnapshot(): story.active / chapter / beat / runId, objective id, recent milestones, avFull activation history (complete + handback), Common Ground units, restoration/world identity when present
__voxBundleDiag(): heldChain, tonic, trace length and last trace entry (storyScore.ts:953)

audioCapture.server: PipeWire via pipewire-pulse (/run/user/1000/pulse/native); one existing sink alsa_output.platform-NVDA2014_00.hdmi-stereo, no existing null sink
audioCapture.isolation: probe-owned module-null-sink 'paravoxia_finale_window'; ONLY the probe's Chromium child gets PULSE_SINK=paravoxia_finale_window; recording is of that sink's OWN monitor; system default sink untouched; no other stream moved; no microphone or source device opened; the default monitor is never recorded
audioCapture.verificationBeforeRecording: the sink-inputs attached to the owned sink must be exactly the probe child's process tree; a foreign stream aborts the capture instead of producing a mixed recording
audioCapture.teardown: pactl unload-module of the recorded module id in a finally, with a post-check that the module is gone and Default Sink is unchanged
audioCapture.muteAudioFinding: previewServer.mjs CHROMIUM_ARGS carries --mute-audio and openParavoxia offers no override, so all existing captures in this run were muted at the browser output stage regardless of a 'running' page AudioContext. The --unmuted variant reuses the same shipped headed hardware route and flags with only --mute-audio filtered out; no source edit, never headless, never SwiftShader.
audioCapture.shippedTap: none exists: __voxAudioDiag returns a description string only, and there is no shipped MediaStream/destination tap. An in-page tap would require adding a hook or patching a global, both refused.
